definitions: Carries out or deals with something in a hurried or impetuous way.
Sends or transports with great speed.
Attacks (an enemy or an opposing player) suddenly and with great impetus.
examples: He rushes to catch the train.
The doctor rushes to the emergency.
She rushes her work to finish early.
The company rushes the new product to market.
The player rushes the opponent's goal.
